chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my teachers narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah from Ali ibn Isma'il ibn 'Isa and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Muhammad ibn 'Amr ibn Sa'id al-Zayyat from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Husayn ibn Ali wrote from Mecca to Muhammad ibn Ali: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Husayn ibn Ali to Muhammad ibn Ali and those with him from the Banu Hashim: As for what follows, then whoever joins me will be martyred, and whoever does not join me will not achieve victory. And peace.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Husayn ibn Ali, the third Imam
key_terms.بَنُو هَاشِمٍ: Banu Hashim, the clan of the Prophet
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Muhammad ibn Ali, known as al-Hanafiyyah

ai.seo_question: What did Husayn ibn Ali write to Muhammad ibn Ali regarding martyrdom and victory?
ai.summary: This epistle from Imam Husayn (a.s.) to his brother Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah in Mecca serves as a pivotal prophetic announcement of the Battle of Karbala, distinguishing between the spiritual reward of martyrdom and the missed opportunity of 'victory' (al-Fath) for those who remained in Mecca. In Shia tradition, this letter underscores the inevitability of the Imam's stand against tyranny and clarifies that physical presence was not the sole criterion for success, as those who stayed behind were not necessarily condemned but simply did not share in the specific merit of the Karbala event.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 15. My father (rah) and all of my teachers narrated to me from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ali b. Isma'il b. ‘Isa and from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abil Khattab from Muhammad b. Amru b. Sa'eed al-Zayyat from Abdillah b. Bukayr from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (as) who said:

Husayn b. Ali (as) wrote a letter in Makkah to Muhammad b. Ali (i.e., al-Hanafiyyah) which read: "In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful, from al-Husayn b. Ali to Muhammad b. Ali and to those with him from among the Bani Hashim: Verily those who join me will be martyred and those who stay behind will not achieve victory - wasalam (and peace)."
